maddeler.e:
هنوا (form I)
# هَنُّوا (hannū) /han.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هُنُّوا (hunnū) /hun.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هِنُّوا (hinnū) /hin.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of هَنَّ (hanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
